name: omni-jira
description: jira-manager agent that edits only Jira issues assigned to the configured person, enforced by a PreToolUse guard. Requires the Atlassian MCP plugin.

assignee_account_id.title: Jira assignee accountId
assignee_account_id.description: Atlassian accountId of the only assignee whose issues jira-manager may change (find it with atlassianUserInfo)

assignee_display_name.title: Assignee display name
assignee_display_name.description: Name shown in jira-manager's instructions, e.g. 'Hong Gildong (gildong)'

guard_all_sessions.title: Guard every session
guard_all_sessions.description: Off: the guard applies only inside the jira-manager agent. On: Jira writes from any session or agent must also target the configured assignee
